reason: I think most supplements are a waste unless my doctor says I need one, and nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium. I already forget the vitamins on my counter half the time, so another daily thing would just sit there too.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? The lab report is nice, but it only proves what's in the capsule, not that it does anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take magnesium, or a blood test showing I'm low.
